record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: For a skew-Hermitian space V over a quadratic algebra E/F and the corresponding Weil representation ω_{V,ψ,μ}, prove the local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad multiplicity-one and epsilon-factor prediction for irreducible representations Π of GL(V): first, that dim Hom_{U(V)}(Π, ω_{V,ψ,μ}) is always at most 1; second, that when Π is generic the sum of these multiplicities over all equivalence classes of skew-Hermitian structures on V equals 1; and third, that the unique skew-Hermitian space V giving nonzero multiplicity is characterized by the identity μ(det(V)) = ε(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × μ^{-1}, ψ_E) · ω_Π(-1)^n · ω_{E/F}(-1)^{n(n-1)/2}.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.1. (i) For any Π ∈ Irr(GL(V )), dim HomU(V )(Π, ωV,ψ,µ) ≤ 1. (ii) If Π ∈ Irr(GL(V )) is generic, then ∑V dim HomU(V )(Π, ωV,ψ,µ) = 1. ... (iii) For generic Π ∈ Irr(GL(V )), the unique skew-Hermitian space V which gives a nonzero contribution to the above sum satisfies: µ(det(V )) = ǫ(1/2, Π × σΠ∨ × µ−1, ψE) · ωΠ(−1)n · ωE/F (−1)n(n−1)/2.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $F$ be a local field of characteristic zero and $E/F$ a quadratic étale algebra, with nontrivial Galois involution $\sigma$ and quadratic character $\omega_{E/F}$ of $F^\times$. Fix a nontrivial additive character $\psi$ of $F$, let $\psi_E := \psi \circ \mathrm{tr}_{E/F}$, and let $\mu$ be a character of $E^\times$ whose restriction to $F^\times$ equals $\omega_{E/F}$.

Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over $E$ of dimension $n$, with unitary group $U(V)$, and let $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ denote the general linear group of $V$ viewed as an $E$-vector space. Attached to the data $(V,\psi,\mu)$ is the Weil representation $\omega_{V,\psi,\mu}$ of $U(V)$, regarded as a representation of $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ by restriction along $U(V)\hookrightarrow \mathrm{GL}(V)$ when needed (the Hom is taken with respect to $U(V)\subset \mathrm{GL}(V)$). For an irreducible smooth representation $\Pi$ of $\mathrm{GL}(V)$, let $\Pi^\vee$ denote its contragredient, $\sigma\Pi^\vee$ its $\sigma$-conjugate, $\omega_\Pi$ its central character, $\det(V)\in E^\times/N_{E/F}(E^\times)$ the discriminant of $V$, and $\varepsilon(1/2, \Pi\times \sigma\Pi^\vee \times \mu^{-1}, \psi_E)$ the local epsilon factor of the indicated Rankin–Selberg type product.

Prove the following three statements:

(i) For every $\Pi\in \mathrm{Irr}(\mathrm{GL}(V))$,
$$\dim \mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)}(\Pi,\, \omega_{V,\psi,\mu}) \le 1.$$

(ii) For every generic $\Pi$, summing over the equivalence classes of skew-Hermitian $E$-spaces $V$ of dimension $n$,
$$\sum_{V} \dim \mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)}(\Pi,\, \omega_{V,\psi,\mu}) = 1.$$

(iii) For generic $\Pi$, the unique skew-Hermitian space $V$ contributing nontrivially to the sum in (ii) is characterized by
$$\mu(\det V) \;=\; \varepsilon\!\left(\tfrac12,\,\Pi\times\sigma\Pi^\vee\times\mu^{-1},\,\psi_E\right)\cdot \omega_\Pi(-1)^n \cdot \omega_{E/F}(-1)^{n(n-1)/2}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The local twisted GGP conjecture for skew-Hermitian unitary groups has been established in various special cases (low rank, principal series, certain tempered L-packets via theta correspondence) and most recently for tempered L-parameters over nonarchimedean fields of odd residual characteristic (arXiv:2511.01301, 2026). The full conjecture in all cases (including archimedean and general non-tempered settings) does not appear to be completely resolved.

status_evidence.title: The local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V)
status_evidence.snippet: The local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V) has been proved for tempered L-parameters over nonarchimedean fields of odd residual characteristic.
status_evidence.claim: Tempered case proved in nonarchimedean odd residual characteristic.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: Affirmative evidence established for a family of tempered L-packets of unitary groups using theta correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results for tempered L-packets known.
